feature: Flyer trial PR 6: the check-in on Home. The 'How's it going?' sheet (phone, S1 to S4 of Survey-Phone) and modal (desktop, S5 and S6 of Survey-Desktop), opened from Home about 1.5 seconds after it settles once the reader is due.
note: Signed in, FEEDBACK_ENABLED=true for the account, on local-dev or a scratch branch. The harness CANNOT force 'due' (14 days since the first Home load AND 5 distinct UTC days; `check_in_state` is written by the action itself), so the one photographed row is the quiet case: Home with the switch on and the reader not due draws no dialog. Walked by hand after setting the account's `check_in_state` row (first_seen_at 15 days back, visit_days 5, last_visit_day yesterday, ended_at and snoozed_until null) on a scratch branch and reloading Home: S1 empty (Send dim, Takes a minute shown at 1300 only), S2/S5 answered (rating 4, Decks + Shopping, Already have, a note; Send live), S3/S6 sent (the thanks, Close), S4 failed (stop the network, press Send: the shared toast with Try again, answers kept), Not now (sheet closes; snoozed_until three days on, snoozes 1; reload shows nothing; the fourth Not now sets ended_at), the X (ended_at set, never opens again), and Send (one `check_in` row in feedback with source home, ended_at set). With FEEDBACK_ENABLED off nothing mounts and checkInDue returns false without writing.
